# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

He is round-faced and perpetually smiling.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

He is stupid, good-natured, and far too shy to do his own courting. He is a great worker with no bad habits who can be depended upon.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Goals

- Marry Anne Shirley  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews lived in Avonlea and was long enamored of Anne Shirley. After his father gave him ownership of the upper farm, he decided to seek marriage. Being too shy to propose himself, he persuaded his sister Jane to propose to Anne on his behalf, offering to wait until Anne finished college. After Anne rejected the proposal, Billy eventually married Nettie Blewett, attending church proudly with his new bride.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_

- Received the upper farm in his own name from his father  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
